children: Renesas announced the SLG46801, a small configurable mixed-signal GreenPAK IC with multi-time programmability, in 9-ball WLCSP and 12-lead STQFN packages. STQFN samples now; WLCSP mass production is planned for November 2026.

AI Analyst View
New SLG46801 configurable IC launched
Expands mixed-signal lineup targeting wearables/IoT, supporting ASP and TAM in low-power edge devices.
WLCSP mass production Nov 2026
Timing guides when volume revenue could start; watch for production ramp and design wins.
Ultra-compact 1.155×1.155 mm WLCSP
Enables tighter designs in wearables/VR, improving win rates vs rivals in space-constrained SKUs.
Multi-time programmable NVM via I²C
In-field reconfig boosts value vs discretes; can reduce BOM and redesign costs for OEMs.
Operates from 1.71 V to 5.5 V
Broad voltage range widens addressable applications and simplifies design-in.
STQFN sampling now
Early customer sampling is a precursor to design-ins; monitor for design-win disclosures.

This is a mid-cycle portfolio addition to Renesas’s GreenPAK line, aiming at continued share in compact, low-power devices. A larger catalyst would require notable design-win disclosures or revenue contribution timelines as WLCSP enters mass production.
